Download the installer for your system below.

- **macOS** — `.dmg` (Apple Silicon: `arm64`, Intel: `x64`). The build is not signed, so the first launch needs a right-click on the app in Applications, then **Open** → **Open**. If macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Sticky Board.app"`.
- **Windows** — `.exe` installer (`x64` or `arm64`). SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" on the first run: click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

Projects are `.board.json` files and open in any version of the app.
